subject: RE: CAIQ/SIG evidence — KEK wrapping, ephemeral KEK lifecycle

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@clearline.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearline.com
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ: KEK wrapping + ephemeral KEK lifecycle details request

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our CAIQ/SIG review we need a focused package that covers tenant key-encryption-key (KEK) handling for ephemeral KEKs used by your hosted offering. Specifically we need the following: 

- HSM attestation copy for the HSMs that perform KEK wrapping (FIPS-level if available)
- A short description of the KEK derivation process (KDF/algorithms) and where the ephemeral KEKs are stored (if at all)
- Rotation cadence for KEKs and a sample rotation log extract (last 12 months)
- Manifest with checksums for any artifacts you provide (SHA256)
- Evidence that in-transit wrapping/unwrapping is protected (TLS versions/ciphers + mutual TLS if used)

Can you deliver these as a zipped package or provide an S3/Drive link? Target for compliance review is next Tuesday (2028-02-22). If anything above is unclear, let me know.

Thanks,
Michael Chen
Senior Security Engineer — ClearLine Finance
security@clearline.com

Attachments: None
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@clearline.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ: KEK wrapping + ephemeral KEK lifecycle details request

Hi Michael —

Appreciate the clear list. We can assemble a focused package; high-level answers below and we'll attach artifacts in a follow-up by end of day Friday (2028-02-18).

High-level: 
- HSMs: KEK wrapping/unwrapping is performed by AWS CloudHSM clusters (customer-dedicated clusters for Dedicated/Private, shared Redwoods-managed clusters for hosted where permitted). We will include the latest HSM attestation PDF (FIPS 140-2/140-3 abstracts where applicable).
- KEK derivation: Ephemeral KEKs are derived using HKDF-SHA256 from an envelope key seed; we'll include the algorithm summary, KDF parameters (salt/Info usage), and references to the runbook.
- Storage: Ephemeral KEKs are kept only in-memory on the serving hosts and never persisted to persistent disk; we will include pointer logs demonstrating no disk writes and our KV-cache lifecycle notes.
- Rotation: KEKs rotate on-demand (triggered by policy) and on a quarterly scheduled cadence for root envelope keys. We'll provide a redacted rotation-log sample and the rotation-runbook extract.
- In-transit: All control-plane wrapping operations use mTLS between service endpoints and TLS1.3 for external links; we'll provide cipher lists and capture examples.

Clarification questions: 
1) Do you require a specific HSM vendor attestation (e.g., signed AWS CloudHSM cert) or is a vendor-issued attestation + our internal usage statement sufficient?
2) Is the checksum manifest format you prefer CSV or a simple SHA256 text file?

I'll loop in Laura (packaging) and Priyom (logs/checksums) to assemble.

-Karthik
Senior Director, Product Security (Redwood Inference)

- redwood-ephemeral-kek-manifest.csv (columns: artifact_name, sha256, size_bytes, notes) — Priyom to generate checksums

- kek-wrapping-runbook.md (excerpted runbook for CAIQ) — Laura
- checksum-manifest-20280218.txt (alternate flat SHA256 list) — Priyom

Packaging rules: 
- No raw customer keys in any file. Redact any tenant IDs or replace with stable pseudonyms.
- Include a 1-page cover note that maps each artifact to the CAIQ/SIG question IDs (we'll use a simple table).
- Use AES-256 encrypted zip or put files in our secure S3 folder and provide pre-signed URL with 7-day expiry.

S3 target (internal): https://s3.redwood-internal/clearline/CL-2027-1897/evidence/

Laura — please confirm the HSM attestation is the vendor-signed AWS CloudHSM doc + our usage page. Priyom — add SHA256 checksums and a checksum manifest in both CSV and flat text. 

Thanks — keep this narrow and labeled so they can map directly into the CAIQ spreadsheet.

-Karthik
